fusions.name: Matted Lash
fusions.desc: A lash at range that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times at maximum range, and costs 4% of your maximum health. Each hit has a 30% chance of leaving the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shedding Cloud
fusions.desc: Shakes out a cone that deals 11 damage to everything caught in it and knocks it back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 60% chance of leaving the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Groomed Pelt
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% and your dodge chance by 8% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Thick Underfur
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
